sentences.text:
The application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973('Code', for short),
for an order of pre-arrest bail.

2. The petitioner is the sole accused in Crime No.784/2023 of Chalissery Police Station, Palakkad,
registered against him for allegedly committing the offences punishable under Sections 405, 406 &
420 of the Indian Penal Code,1860.
3.

When the bail application came up for consideration on 05.12.2023, this Court passed an interim order, by directing the petitioner to surrender before the Investigating Officer within one week from the date of order and subject himself for interrogation.

4. Heard; Sri. P. Mohamed Sabah, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner; Smt. Seetha S.,
the learned Senior Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondents 1 & 2 and Sri. C.K. Anwar, the learned counsel appearing for the de-facto complainant/ intervenor.
5.

The learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, submitted that, pursuant to the order dated 05.12.2023 passed by this Court, the petitioner appeared before the Investigating Officer on 07.12.2023 and his interrogation has been completed.
The petitioner's further presence is not required.
Hence, the interim order can be made absolute, subject to additional conditions.
( iii) The petitioner shall not get involved in any other offence while on bail.

opennyai_summary.decision:
When the bail application came up for consideration on 05.12.2023, this Court passed an interim order, by directing the petitioner to surrender before the Investigating Officer within one week from the date of order and subject himself for interrogation.
The learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, submitted that, pursuant to the order dated 05.12.2023 passed by this Court, the petitioner appeared before the Investigating Officer on 07.12.2023 and his interrogation has been completed.
The petitioner's further presence is not required.
Hence, the interim order can be made absolute, subject to additional conditions.
The said submission is recorded.
Resultantly, the bail application is disposed of by making the interim order dated 05.12.2023 absolute, subject to the following conditions:
(i) The petitioner shall co-operate with the investigation and make himself available for interrogation and for the purpose of investigation as and when the Investigating Officer directs;
(ii) The petitioner shall not intimidate witnesses or interfere with the investigation in any manner;
( iii) The petitioner shall not get involved in any other offence while on bail.
(iv) The petitioner shall not leave India without the permission of the jurisdictional Court;
